name: ky-ai
description: Optional Claude Code plugins that wire the KY.AI tools into every session, instead of a per-project .mcp.json.

plugins.name: ky-ai-ng
plugins.description: Angular dev servers (ng serve / ng build) — build state and logs over MCP.

plugins.name: ky-ai-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET backends (dotnet watch run / build) — build state and logs over MCP.

plugins.name: ky-ai-browser
plugins.description: Browser console capture and supervised interaction for apps served by ky-ai-ng.

plugins.name: ky-ai-terminal
plugins.description: Shared interactive terminal — you drive, the agent rides along. Windows-only.

plugins.name: ky-ai-wpf
plugins.description: Focus-free UI Automation for running WPF/WinForms/Win32 windows. Windows-only.
